name: Trade On Orion stake-release liability desynchronization
summary: OrionVault.requestReleaseStake() credited locked ORN directly back to the caller's internal asset balance and cleared the stake without reconciling an existing ORN liability. Repeating the stake-release and redeem cycle therefore left duplicate liability entries for the same asset. MarginalFunctionality.calcLiabilities() valued every entry from the same live balance, so a later positive ORN balance was counted several times as collateral and checkPosition() accepted large unsupported debits that the attacker withdrew. The deployed redeemAtomic path did require the recovered signature to equal order.sender; the seed row's signature-bypass classification was incorrect.
notes: The last of 29 pre-anchor EIP-1967 Upgraded events emitted by the Exchange proxy selects implementation 0xc662cea3d8d6660ca97fb9ff98122da69a199cd8. The EIP-1967 implementation slot still contains that address at block 39106262. Its runtime hash is 0x9ef75aa9a55328c6edd7b4f3b060d206c32ae4fd2110f9b4f0276f2ae511b64d at its deployment block 36708281, the selection block, sampled intermediate blocks and block 39106262, so this is the complete pre-anchor code boundary for the defect-bearing implementation.

The loss is the exact campaign-attributable depletion of the Exchange proxy's external asset balances. In the final drain transaction, the proxy lost 19,844.686077960000000000 USDT net of the 4,000,000 USDT flash-funded deposit made inside that transaction, and sent 498,921.92920826 ORN, 62,444.730331000000000000 XRP and 79.896159740000000000 native BNB to attacker-controlled addresses. Before the drain, the same campaign had externally deposited 1.000000000000000000 USDT and 0.30000000 ORN into the proxy in the three transactions listed in source-7; excluding that attacker-supplied capital leaves the four asset components recorded above. The flash pair retained 10,400 USDT on repayment, so attacker proceeds were lower than victim depletion by that financing fee. No recovery is netted. The USD total uses stablecoin par and DefiLlama's token-specific incident-time prices of USD 1.44/ORN, USD 0.52477/XRP and USD 595.9736912132389/BNB. The widely reported approximately USD 645,000 estimate is not used because it does not reproduce the exact onchain quantities at contemporaneous prices.
